service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Configured ads and transient request data in memory; no durable local state.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Immutable configuration plus shared event context; pod memory is disposable.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Derive selection and result from page-view message ID and configuration revision.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Run definitions, CAS lease, Job identity, heartbeats, terminal status, and summaries live in BENCHMARK_RUNS KV; artifacts live in BENCHMARK_ARTIFACTS Object Store; every run executes in a disposable Kubernetes Job.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Replicated JetStream KV and Object Store plus one Kubernetes Job per run.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Run ID is the submission key; lease CAS makes create, cancel, observe, and finalize repeatable.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Cart-keyed state, versions, inbox identities, and exact deterministic result journals are committed atomically in the cart Redis Cluster; a shared replayable Redis catalog projection validates add-item commands; handlers republish stored results before acknowledging.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Cart-keyed clustered Redis records with atomic inbox, aggregate transition, and stored deterministic results; catalog validation uses a shared replayable projection.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Input message ID is the inbox key, user ID is the transaction partition, and duplicate inputs republish stored result slots.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Each order saga, immutable accepted snapshot, applied input journal, exact result messages, and deadline metadata are committed in one order shard; handler replicas publish their stored results and deadline replicas use expiring fencing leases.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Order-keyed clustered Redis saga/result records, per-key shared projections, and leased partitioned deadline indexes.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Input message ID or stable synthetic deadline ID is committed with all deterministic result slots in the order partition; duplicates republish exact bytes and provider keys are order ID plus step.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Configured rates have a content-derived revision; replicas coordinate snapshot publication through an expiring BOOTSTRAP_CLAIMS KV lease and publish stable event IDs.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Immutable configured snapshot with a content revision and shared NATS KV bootstrap claim.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Snapshot and rate event IDs derive from the content revision; concurrent bootstrap republishes the same logical revision.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: The demo notification provider and result envelope are deterministic from the order notification key and source event; pods retain no outcome state.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Deterministic demo provider behavior or provider receipts in an email-owned external store.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Order ID plus notification type is the provider key; retries reuse the stored or deterministic result.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Signed client identity, request-scoped data, and disposable polling/SSE connections; authoritative reads use storefront queries.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Signed cookies/request IDs and shared storefront views only.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: HTTP retries reuse the original operation/command ID and never require replica affinity.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Disposable Locust worker state and benchmark inputs supplied at process start.
service_state_inventory.target_store: External run definition and output destination; workers remain disposable.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Each simulated retry retains its original business idempotency key and operation ID.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Immutable replay payload records live in BOUTIQUE_DLQ and administrator-safe case lifecycle metadata lives in DLQ_CASES KV; service pods retain no correctness state.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Replicated JetStream DLQ and KV metadata with compare-and-set lifecycle transitions.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Source stream, consumer, and stream sequence derive the stable case and DLQ identity; advisory retries converge and each administrator replay attempt has a stable transport identity.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Replica-shared key-ID-addressed signing sets support an explicit overlap window; provider calculations are deterministic and there is no outcome registry.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Identical active signing-key set on every replica; no pod-owned provider state.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Validated input and business idempotency key fully determine authorization, capture, and release results.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Configured catalog has a content-derived revision; replicas coordinate snapshot publication through an expiring BOOTSTRAP_CLAIMS KV lease and publish stable per-product event IDs.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Immutable configured snapshot with content revision and shared NATS KV bootstrap claim.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Product and snapshot event IDs derive from the catalog content revision and product identity.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: A shared durable applies versioned catalog events to RECOMMENDATION_CATALOG KV with CAS; recommendation requests read the shared revisioned catalog.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Shared JetStream KV catalog projection with optional revision-aware disposable cache.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Trigger message ID plus model/configuration revision determines the result ID and candidates.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: The demo carrier derives quote, shipment, tracking, cancellation, timestamp, and result identities from validated inputs, stable input time, and a replica-shared provider secret.
service_state_inventory.target_store: Deterministic demo provider behavior or shipping-owned external receipts for a non-idempotent real provider.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Command business key and stable input time reproduce quote, shipment, tracking, cancellation, and result values.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: Optional undeployed service keeps request work in process memory.
service_state_inventory.target_store: External operation state and object references before the service is enabled.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Operation ID is the request key and result message ID derives from the triggering command.

service_state_inventory.current_correctness_state: JetStream KV is authoritative for every query; projection workers apply source event IDs and aggregate versions with bounded CAS retries and stale-event skips.
service_state_inventory.target_store: JetStream KV is authoritative; any cache is revision-aware and populated from KV.
service_state_inventory.idempotency_contract: Source event ID and aggregate version are stored in each view; stale or duplicate events are no-ops under CAS.
